# Local Service Spotlight Skills

> Portable skill library that lets AI agents (Claude, Grok, and others) share one canonical source of instructions, standards, and operational memory, so they can pick up each other's work.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): installation, bundles, and what gets installed
- [Agent collaboration playbook](docs/agent-collaboration-playbook.md): how to equip your agents to work together — start here for the process
- [How knowledge propagates](HOW-KNOWLEDGE-PROPAGATES.md): how one markdown rule reaches every agent and every check
- [Acceptance checks](ACCEPTANCE.md): receipts that prove installs, updates, and jobs actually ran
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): branch-and-PR workflow and CI validation

## Key files

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the operating manual agents read first
- [standards/](standards/): house rules, one file each, single source of truth
- [skills/](skills/): the skills themselves, one folder per skill
